> I would keep the no-qualifying-elements set to false. There are some edge cases when one might need to rely on them to enforce specific styles. Same for nesting-depth.

Ok. What about I disable those rules for some files using `// sass-lint:disable`? @ronanlevesque 

The idea is that we are only using warning as it is the only to get all the errors at once. Of course then we should make sure that we never have warnings :)
